method: Calls of single Rhinolophus capensis flying alone in a large outdoor netted flight cage (10 m x 3 m x 2 m) recorded with a multi-microphone array, Avisoft USGH 1216 A/D converter at 300 kHz per channel (16 bit), analysed in BatSound 4; peak frequency from the power spectrum (FFT size 1024, Hann window) of each call; duty cycle = average call duration divided by average call period for each bat.
conditions: Solo column of Table 1: five different R. capensis (Table 1 footnote: 'Five different R. capensis were measured in each group'; 21 R. capensis caught in all).
